limits: IA ICCmax is a stored configuration field, not measured current. Only 06_97 steppings 0,1,2,4,5 and 06_9A steppings 1,2,3,4 are supported. No B7, other rails or server contract inferred.
Bit31 semantics remain unverified because the public comment and CPU table disagree. Bit31 set, sub-1 A/default codes and OC lock are read only. No unlimited-mode changes or MSR601 shortcut.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.
No hardware settings were written or measured. Synthetic update/readback tests do not validate a physical CPU or power rail.
